rows.44:f188:
...This {f:isn't|isn't} one of Hino's pranks.
I don't think even Hino would go as far as special-effects makeup like this just for a joke.
Standing there were two musclebound ammonite freaks... no, two Sunbararians.
"When danger approaches, we transform into our battle form. You are not a Sunbararian, are you? You are a spy posing as a Sunbararian, aren't you?★ I knew it!☆ Now that we know you are a spy, you must die!☆"
The former Kazama and the Commander crept closer and closer to {f:me|me},
stretching out the slimy tentacles around their mouths...{p}
rows.44:f79c:
The two Sunbararians had vanished without a trace.
Thanks to that young man, the Earth had escaped its crisis.
...But.
Maybe {f:I|I} had dreamed all of this.
Yes, that {f:was it|had to be it}...
On an impulse, {f:I|I} looked out the window.{p}
rows.44:fe90:
"They say that in this so-called spirit world, there is a paradise that even Earthlings long for. I investigated it on my own as well. Apparently ordinary people can hardly ever get there. ...However, I have finally discovered it! The way to reach that paradise!☆"
The Commander and Kazama cried out in admiration.
"How can one get there?!"
Milking the moment, {f:I|I} said,
"Do you want to know?"
They both nodded hard.
"Then, both of you, please take off all your clothes."{p}Would the two of them {f:do|do} what {f:I|I} said?
rows.44:10098:
The two of them said in unison,
"...All right, understood!"
{f:I|I} didn't much want to see them naked, but it {f:was|was} their punishment for trying to fool {f:me|me}.
Sorry, but {f:I'll|I'll} have {f:you|you} make a shameful spectacle of yourselves.
"Please hand me the clothes you take off. Then stand side by side by the window."
{f:I|I} felt a little smug watching them do exactly as they were told.
Honestly, Hino and the others just love getting carried away with a gag.
"Close your eyes and concentrate your minds."
Meaning to give them a scare, {f:I|I} pointed the toy gun the Commander had been carrying at them.
"Now, please turn this way."{p}
rows.44:107d4:
"I quit!☆ I can't stand this role anymore. Nobody told me it'd go this far."
The Commander slid his mask off with a slither.
Standing there was a completely ordinary person with an ordinary face.
Kazama spoke to him.{p}
rows.44:10aa8:
"{f:Sorry|I'm so sorry}, I never meant for this to happen. Please, forgive me. {f:I'm|I'm} actually an Earthling. {f:I'm|I'm} just a good, ordinary citizen, and I'm definitely not with the Earth Defense Force."
A good citizen who just killed the Commander? Not likely, {f:huh|right}... even I had to admit that.
Even so, Kazama kept closing in on {f:me|me}, step by steady step.
{f:It's no use|It's hopeless}. No matter how much {f:I|I} apologized, he wasn't going to listen.
K-Kazama, if you come any closer, {f:we're|we're} going to be skin to skin.{p}
rows.44:12024:
"Tra-la-la, tra-la-la-la-la-laaa, ta-dum-ta-ta-ta☆"
Humming the melody, {f:I|I} started dancing by myself.
I was past caring about being embarrassed.
Then {f:I|I} went round and round the club room table.
{f:I|I} glanced sideways at Kazama.{p}
rows.44:12240:
"{a}, that's enough. Stop dancing.
You've proven splendidly that you're a Sunbararian. And you've proven that you're one of the Koppeppo, a brave tribe even among the Sunbararians. I've only seen that dance once myself, but there's no doubt about it. It's a dance handed down among the Koppeppo tribe since ancient times."{p}
rows.44:12358:
I-I didn't know what was going on, but things {f:seemed|seemed} to be going my way.
Just then, a shrill buzzer blared.
Kazama took something like a patch out of his pocket and brought it to his mouth.
"Yes, this is code name ·☆·☆.
My communicator just sounded an alarm. Is something the matter?"
Kazama held the patch up to his ear.{p}
rows.44:13008:
Before me were human heads hanging from an abnormally huge tree.
Looking closely, I saw they all had their eyes wide open, eyeballs darting this way and that.
They all {f:seemed|seemed} shocked to find themselves reduced to just heads.
And it {f:looked|looked} like {f:I|I} was just a head too...
Unfortunately, I couldn't make a sound.
Then some Sunbararians came over from the distance.
They were riding something like flying scooters.{p}
rows.44:1542c:
Oh no!
I said something I didn't mean at all.
And so smoothly, too...
So this patch only translates; it won't interpret what I actually mean{f:!|!}☆
"☆···☆☆★☆★·☆"
(Roger! All right, everyone! Are you ready?)
"{f:Waaah|Nooo}☆ Stoooop!"
The Sunbararians hoisted {f:me|me} up, and every one of them held up a patch.{p}
rows.44:168f0:
"Whoa☆"
Startled, Dr. Tanaka went tumbling over backward.
Half in tears, {f:I|I} said,
"Doctor! It's {a}! {f:I'm|I'm} {b} {a}!"
Flustered, Dr. Tanaka still managed to speak to {f:me|me}.
"Wh-what happened? What's with that head? Is it really you, {a}?"
"Dr. Tanaka☆ Please listen to me..."
Like a dam bursting, {f:I|I} poured out everything that had happened.{p}
rows.44:16e1c:
"Using {a}'s name like that, you unforgivable creature. A who-knows-what alien like you will make fine research material for us! Ha ha ha!"
No... so the doctor never believed {f:me|me} at all{f:!|!}★
{f:I|I} said to the doctor,
"Doctor, {f:I|I} was just wearing that mask, wasn't I?"
"Don't be stupid. That's no mask. That's your own skin, plain and simple. You've got some nerve, telling such a barefaced lie."
{f:I|I} tried to move my body.{p}
